resources.string: Floating time — follows the device time zone. This behavior is preserved when editing.
Silent, inexact Android notifications. Battery settings can delay delivery. No exact-alarm permission is requested.
Notifications are disabled. The event is saved; allow Agenda notifications in Android settings to receive reminders.
A clear day. Tap + to add an event.
No events in the next 90 days. Your local calendar is ready, even offline.
No matching events in this year. Change the selected date to search another year.
Sync incomplete. Cached events and pending changes are preserved. Open settings to retry.
Server rejected authentication or access. Check your account settings. Local data is preserved.
Server conflict — your version is preserved
Nothing was overwritten. Export your version, or keep it as an isolated local copy and reload the server version.
Keep local copy, use server version
This preserves your version in a separate local calendar, then accepts the current server version (or its deletion). It does not overwrite the server.
Protected event: meetings, recurrence exceptions, custom time zones or complex reminders cannot be edited or deleted safely here. Use the original calendar client. The original ICS is preserved.
A sync attempt is pending. Editing is locked until it is reconciled so a lost response cannot cause data loss.
This edits the whole series, not just this occurrence.
Delete this event? For recurring events, this deletes the entire series. Synchronized deletion is queued until the server confirms it.
Check the title, time zone and dates. End must be after start. Times in a daylight-saving gap are not accepted.
Action could not complete. Your existing data has been retained.
This event changed while the editor was open. Nothing was overwritten. Copy your notes, go back and reopen the latest version.
Some events use unsupported data or exceed the recurrence limit. Their original ICS remains stored; they are not silently deleted.
Connect directly to your CalDAV server. No Google account or Android calendar access is used.
WARNING: HTTP sends your password and calendar data unencrypted. Only literal loopback or private LAN IP addresses are allowed. Use HTTPS whenever possible.
No event calendars found. Check the endpoint or enter a direct calendar URL.
Discovery failed. Check the URL, credentials, TLS certificate and server permissions. Redirects to other origins are not followed.
Changing the server or username is blocked while this account is attached. Synchronize pending changes first, then detach while retaining local copies.
Disconnect this account without changing anything on the server? All cached events become isolated local calendars. Pending changes must be synchronized first.
Pending or conflicting changes must be reconciled before detaching.
Private local storage · one CalDAV account · open-source libraries. No analytics, ads, system calendar access or account service.
All-day end date is exclusive (the first day not included).
This event is no longer available.
No calendars are visible. Select a calendar in the menu.
This event has changed. Go back and reopen it before editing or deleting.
Some reminders could not be prepared or delivered. Check notification permission and the affected events, then retry.
